name: fastseo-site
description: Astro static website for Fast Seo / MSEO

scripts.dev: node scripts/build-site.mjs && node scripts/prepare-astro-public.mjs && node scripts/generate-tools-data.mjs && astro dev
scripts.build: npm run fix:seo && npm run fix:images && npm run generate:sitemap && npm run generate:feed && npm run audit:routing && node scripts/build-site.mjs && node scripts/prepare-astro-public.mjs && node scripts/generate-tools-data.mjs && astro build && npm run audit:astro-articles:built
scripts.check:js: node --check assets/js/webmcp.js && node --check assets/js/site.js && node --check assets/js/home.js && node --check assets/js/tools-catalog.js && node --check assets/js/mseo-bottom-tabs.js
scripts.audit: npm run check:js && npm run audit:seo && npm run audit:headings && npm run audit:external-links && npm run audit:links && npm run audit:security && npm run audit:catalog && npm run audit:translations && npm run audit:routing && npm run audit:performance && npm run audit:astro-articles
scripts.audit:ci: npm run check:js && npm run audit:seo && npm run audit:headings && npm run audit:links && npm run audit:security && npm run audit:catalog && npm run audit:routing && npm run audit:performance && npm run audit:astro-articles
